name: panda
description: A panda head with rounded ears, two dark eye patches and a nose.
useCase: Choose a panda in an animal selector or nature guide.
misuse: Pair the stylized head with its name when identifying an animal.

16.reason: The shared round head stays centered; both dark ear shapes, complete eye patches and nose retain their space.

24.reason: The independently drawn interface master preserves the defining facial parts with larger clear space.
